Dear Madam
I am much obliged for your paper, which I think excellent but I fear it is impossible to insert it before July[^1]

yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: If the article was indeed inserted in the July 1892 issue of MP it must have been one of two contributions to the series \'Work and Workers.

By the Actual Workers\', either \'Women as Librarians\' by L.M.H.C, one of the librarians of the People\'s Palace, or \'Elementary School Teaching\', signed C. H..
